svg.title: Escape Room Adventure | Manual save and safe restoration

g.text: Escape Room Adventure | Manual save and safe restoration
Controller dispatches both commands to the same serial worker.
Entity mutations and file operations never run on Swing's EDT.
SAVE: requires a current ACTIVE or ESCAPED game
Capture ALL rooms, including hidden items and unvisited rooms:
object values and completed one-shot actions,
exactly every room's door ItemLock and exit TriviaLock,
original questions/answers, generated values, current room and status.
Successor structure is retained in the compatible immutable template,
with no duplicate next-room or final-room flags in schema 4.
Items acquired on action appearance / room entry are already INVENTORY;
each configured item still occurs exactly once, with no acquisition ledger.
Snapshot capture does not mutate the game.
Keep the previous save file and current Game unchanged.
An incomplete temp file never replaces the valid save.
If atomic replacement is unsupported, report failure;
do not fall back to truncating the destination file.
Clean up the temporary file after any failed save.
LOAD: also available from the main menu
read, validate a candidate, then replace
Loading never requires an existing Game.
No context.replace() occurs on any failure path.
Rebuild a separate candidate from saved generated values,
ALL item locations, object/action state and lock/question state.
Restore the one finite forward path from the matching template:
every predecessor of the saved current room must have BOTH gates passed.
Current-room gates may be incomplete in either order; reject unreachable positions.
startingRoomId visits every room exactly once, ending at no successor.
Reject broken references, self-loops, cycles or unreachable rooms.
Changed successors or appearance rules require a new template version;
incompatible versions are rejected without migration.
Each configured item occurs exactly once in ROOM or INVENTORY.
ROOM roomId matches the template's configured owning room;
INVENTORY has no roomId and each held item is revealed.
An unlocked door requires ALL its requiredItemIds in INVENTORY.
A locked door with every required item held is valid:
its explicit unlock command may not yet have occurred.
Both door and exit Trivia locks are included for EVERY room.
Either gate may already be passed while the other remains locked.
TEMPLATE questions match the template resolved with saved values;
retained API questions are not fetched again.
Validate object state/action IDs, generated values, current room
and status; ESCAPED requires currentRoom.nextRoomId empty
Missing/duplicate state or any older schema is rejected,
uses NO random generation and makes NO trivia/API request.
State construction restores saved locations exactly, without enterRoom
or acquisition. Loading never replays obtained-item notices.
[schema, template or restored state fails validation]
[a current game exists after the operation]
Failure: display the original game, unchanged.
This diagram shows runtime calls; source dependencies point to owned interfaces:
controller -> input boundary <- interactor -> data-access port <- JSON adapter.
Presenter implements GameOutputBoundary; no interactor imports its concrete class.
Files, JSON libraries and Swing types stay outside use_case and entity.
Expected answers remain inside the save snapshot and never enter UI output.
Every result refreshes the view. Save/load messages never reannounce held items.
